__inputs.description: Logs from Arcane and its web UI

description: Official Arcane dashboard for its OpenTelemetry metrics, traces, and logs: API traffic, Docker inventory and containers, jobs, vulnerabilities, edge agents, GitOps, backups, runtime, database, dependencies, browser experience, and logs. Expects Prometheus (OTLP or remote write with metric suffixes), Tempo, and Loki.
